verdict.rationale: Firebase's official CLI (firebase-tools) explicitly supports non-interactive environments via `login:ci`, which generates an auth token for CI. It also deploys code with one command from the command line. The Local Emulator Suite and Test SDK support automated integration and unit testing without touching production. missing for 10: in-depth first-party CI/headless documentation (e.g. service-account auth, CI pipeline integration guides), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: login:ci | Generate an authentication token for use in non-interactive environments.
Deploy your JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python code to our servers with one command from the command line.
you can connect your app directly to these emulators to perform integration testing or QA without touching production data.
Unit Tests: using the Firebase Test SDK, you can write unit tests in Node.js using the mocha test runner.
